messages:
mara: heads-up — noticed the cache credits card in console shows negative savings for some tenants after last deploy. can someone triage?

sahil: saw that too. looks like the prefetched KV hits are being double-counted against both the prefetch owner and the hotpath owner in the cost pipeline.

anya: double-counting would definitely flip some tiny tenants to negative. is this the recent change to allocation when we attribute by invocation path?

jeff: yup — patch 2f9b changed the claim window to 'session' instead of 'invocation' to try and be less noisy. unintended side effect: when a session replays prefixes we grant both prefetch_credit and hotpath_credit.

mara: quick ask: can we roll back that part of the change? or do a fix at the costing layer to dedupe claims before aggregation?

sahil: my preference is fix in costing layer — simpler for console to remain read-only. propose a dedupe rule: for same kv_fingerprint within session window, prefer the earliest claimant (prefetch) and zero out subsequent claims.

anya: we need to be careful — earliest claimant heuristic will favor prefetchers and make hotpath teams look worse. what if the hotpath actually used the KV and prefetch never saved net compute because of eviction?

matt: good point. eviction/open-addressing makes pure-first-wins wrong. We should consider a 'realized hit' signal from the runtime: runtime emits kv_realized_hit=true when the request actually consumes cached KV. Then costing just sums realized_hit credits.

jeff: runtime signal would be ideal but needs a small schema change and 1 FLAG in router. timeline?

mara: can we add a temporary shim in the attribution service that inspects request.trace and uses heuristics: if an invocation includes a kvcache_lookup and kvcache_miss then any prior prefetch claim for that fingerprint in the session should be revoked. less ideal but faster.

sahil: yeah that heuristic would avoid giving credit when the eventual hotpath missed. code sketch: 

```json
// attribution dedupe pseudo
if (invocation.kv_lookup == true && invocation.kv_hit == false) {
  revoke_prefetch_claim(fingerprint, session_id)
}
```

anya: fine as interim. but we need a test harness: sample generator that creates replayed prefixes, evictions, and racing prefetch. otherwise we're just guessing.

matt: I'll add a replay test to the econ-sim harness. can someone write expected metrics for the console to display while we iterate?

mara: minimal console contract:
- prefetched_savings (tokens)
- realized_prefetch_hits (count)
- hotpath_extra_cost (tokens)
- net_savings = prefetched_savings - hotpath_extra_cost

sahil: console also wants a tiny hovercard explaining methodology and a badge when data is provisional (sampling < 100%). suggestion: show :hourglass: when sample_rate < 1.

jeff: UX nit: prefer 'provisional' badge to 'hourglass' emoji for accessibility. can we expose reason codes (deduped_by_heuristic, revoked_by_miss, ttl_eviction) in the hovercard?

anya: yes please. that helps SREs and CS when they get questions. but remember agents.md — we should avoid dumping raw IDs. map codes to friendly strings server-side.

matt: timeline: I can add tests + schema in 2 days, attribution shim in 1 day, console hovercard tweak in 1. if we agree, I'll open a PR.

mara: sounds good. @jeff can you do the router trace flag? that might block the 'realized hit' signal later.

jeff: on it — will add a bool kvcache_realized_hit to trace v2 and gate behind feature flag `kvcache_realized_hit`. will include a small migration note.

sahil: one more API question: for the attribution service endpoint, do we accept both fingerprint and model_sku? some tenants want per-model unit economics.

anya: we should. schema: { fingerprint, model_sku, claim_type: [prefetch|hotpath], session_id, realized_hit } — minimal. but remember to keep fields optional for older traces.

mara: ok final action list:
1) matt: add replay+eviction tests to econ-sim (2d)
2) sahil: implement attribution shim dedupe (1d)
3) jeff: add kvcache_realized_hit trace flag (1d)
4) anya: console hovercard + provisional badge + reason map (1d)
5) mara: follow-up rollout plan and inform CS about provisional data

mara: thanks team. if anyone wants to take ownership of the PR review ping me. also filing a tiny incident ticket so CS doesn't panic. :+1:

costbot: incident created — #INC-2026-1147 — prefetched-credits-negative-savings. assigned to eng-platform.

jeff: opened PR 4689 with trace flag and mock event. linking in thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4689

matt: created branch econ-sim/prefetch-dedup and pushed tests. will link PR tomorrow.

sahil: started attribution-shim branch. will request review in ~6 hours.

anya: console PR draft up — hovercard copy attached. need final reason strings from sahil.

mara: great — let's sync tomorrow at 11 for a quick rollout guardrail check.
